deduplicate_crystal_structures: deduplicate crystal structures in a pandas DataFrame using hash-based pre-filtering and parallel StructureMatcher comparison
deduplicate_and_remove_duplicates: deduplicate crystal structures and remove duplicates keeping one representative per group from a DataFrame
process_structure_group_clustering: process a pre-filtered structure group and apply greedy clustering with StructureMatcher to find similar crystals
deduplicate_with_custom_tolerance: deduplicate crystal structures with custom lattice, site, and angle tolerance parameters for fine-grained control
review_deduplicate_structures: review the deduplicate_structures function and its two-stage hash-based pre-filtering and parallel crystallographic comparison algorithm
